mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.learning_outcomes (id, code, description, course_id, group_learning_outcome_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{description}, #{courseId}, #{groupLearningOutcomeId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.learning_outcomes SET code = #{code}, description = #{description}, course_id = #{courseId}, group_learning_outcome_id = #{groupLearningOutcomeId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, description, course_id, group_learning_outcome_id, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.learning_outcomes WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND group_learning_outcome_id IS NULL
